representation: A parabola with a movable point, its tangent, and a run-rise triangle at the point.
motion: The x slider moves the point; the tangent and run-rise triangle update from the local slope.
checkpoints: negative x gives a negative rise
positive slope can coexist with a negative function value
misconceptionTest: The derivative is a slope, not the function value; a positive derivative does not imply f(x) is positive.
accessibility: Figure alt text, keyboard-operable slider, rise direction and labels avoid color-only sign.
